title: Boundary Exploration for Bayesian Optimization With Unknown Physical Constraints
problem: Optimize an expensive black-box objective under unknown binary feasibility constraints where infeasible evaluations do not return objective values.

method.objective_surrogate: Gaussian Process over feasible objective observations only
method.constraint_surrogate: Deep ensemble classifier trained with variational inference / ELBO
method.boundary_exploration: Optimize the acquisition subject to 0.5 - sigma_E(x) <= C(x) <= 1, where sigma_E is the ensemble uncertainty.

constraints: c(x) = (r_T + r_S cos(n theta))^2 - x1^2 - x2^2 >= 0
r_T = 1, r_S = 0.2, n = 8, theta = atan2(x1, x2)

implementation_modules.description: Central experiment defaults and hyperparameters shared by all modules.
Seed setup, logging, Sobol sampling, and tensor helpers.
Analytic benchmark definitions, feasibility checks, and initial sample generation.
GP-based surrogate for the objective using feasible observations only.
Deep ensemble classifier that predicts feasibility probability and uncertainty.
Acquisition optimizer with Adam pre-optimization and SLSQP refinement.
Main Bayesian optimization loop wiring together benchmark, GP, classifier, and acquisition optimization.
Computes best feasible objective, feasibility ratio, and balanced accuracy.
Repository entry point that initializes modules and runs the optimization loop.

task_focus: This Harbor task verifies that the synthetic benchmark definitions and benchmark output contract match the paper appendix. It does not require completing the full 12-problem experimental pipeline.
